crew.name: Randy Bresnik
crew.bio: NASA Astronaut, Marine Colonel, former commander of ISS Expedition 53. Test pilot background.

crew.name: Luca Parmitano
crew.bio: ESA Astronaut, Italian Air Force Colonel, former commander of ISS Expedition 61. First European assigned to a crewed Artemis mission.

crew.name: Frank Rubio
crew.bio: NASA Astronaut, Army medical doctor. Holds U.S. single-spaceflight record after 371 days on the ISS (Soyuz MS-22 / MS-23, 2022–2023).

crew.name: Andre Douglas
crew.bio: NASA Astronaut from the 2021 class. Coast Guard officer and engineer. First spaceflight.

backup.name: Bob Hines
backup.bio: NASA Astronaut, Air Force Colonel, ISS Crew-4.
